summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Invesco Agriculture Commodity Strategy No K-1 ETF (PDBA) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in broad market commodities. The fund is an actively managed portfolio that provides exposure to global agricultural commodities through a Cayman Islands subsidiary. PDBA was launched on Aug 24, 2022 and is issued by Invesco.

data.title: Widespread Drought Adds to Stresses for U.S. Farmers. Food Prices Are a Focus.
data.text: Just in time for the start of the growing season, the National Drought Mitigation Center's latest data says that 51% of U.S. states and Puerto Rico are in moderate drought or worse.
